knowledge.name: Synthetic correspondence snapshot
knowledge.detail: Four fictional resident items across email, web form, phone note and scanned letter, with due dates and separate questions.

knowledge.name: Synthetic approved-response library
knowledge.detail: Seven fictional approved responses with owning team, approval date and reusable wording.

knowledge.name: Team directory and routing rules
knowledge.detail: Fictional owning teams, coordinating team per project, match threshold and referral timing rules.

intelligence_processing.name: Queue triage
intelligence_processing.detail: Orders open items by due date and counts questions and gaps across the queue.

intelligence_processing.name: Enquiry decomposition
intelligence_processing.detail: Presents each item as separate numbered questions so no part of a multi-part enquiry is dropped.

intelligence_processing.name: Precedent matching
intelligence_processing.detail: Matches each question to the closest approved response and flags anything below the match threshold as a gap.

intelligence_processing.name: Ownership routing
intelligence_processing.detail: Assigns each question to its owning team and drafts a dated referral question for each gap.

clients_user_interface.name: Portable Brainstem chat experience
clients_user_interface.detail: The single-file agent exposes six routable operations through local Brainstem chat and API surfaces.

clients_user_interface.name: Copilot Studio draft experience
clients_user_interface.detail: Six skills and two synthetic knowledge files support natural-language preview while the agent stays Draft.

management_reporting.name: Correspondence queue
management_reporting.detail: Items, questions and gaps waiting, soonest due first, with a recommended next item.

management_reporting.name: Coverage line on every draft
management_reporting.detail: Shows how many questions are addressed, cited from precedent and flagged for the officer.

management_reporting.name: Library growth proposal
management_reporting.detail: Shows the proposed new library entry, its owner and approval status.

tools.name: PublicCorrespondenceAgent portable RAPP tool
tools.detail: Single-file Python BasicAgent with six deterministic read-only operations over bundled synthetic records.

tools.name: Microsoft Copilot Studio
tools.detail: Hosts the pilot with six skills and two knowledge files; publishing requires explicit confirmation.

tools.name: Microsoft SharePoint
tools.detail: Approved production seam for the approved-response library; not connected in the package.

tools.name: Microsoft Outlook
tools.detail: The officer's own sending channel; the agent never sends or drafts in a mailbox.

tools.name: Microsoft Teams
tools.detail: Documented seam for referrals to owning teams; the package contacts no one.

supporting_features.name: Synthetic-only evidence boundary
supporting_features.detail: Every resident, item, project, team, score and wording is fictional pilot evidence.

supporting_features.name: Every-question coverage
supporting_features.detail: Drafts address each separate question and state the coverage line explicitly.

supporting_features.name: Gap flagging, not guessing
supporting_features.detail: Questions without approved precedent are flagged for the officer and routed, never invented.

supporting_features.name: Officer sign-off boundary
supporting_features.detail: Nothing is sent, no one is contacted and no record or library entry changes.
